summary: Not an object: a raw u8 bit-packed buffer shifted in place by the save-code encoder/decoder (0x005F01AC veneer, shift-right body at 0x005F01D4, opposite-direction routine at 0x005F02E0). Callers pass a local byte array and its length, never an allocated StrBitBuffer.
evidence: struct_db class 'source' is name only (function-name prefix Str_BitBuffer_): signature void Str_BitBuffer_ShiftRight(u8* buf, int size, u32 bits); Save_Crypto_SealBlock 0x005F09A4 calls it with (&local_20, 3, 1) and SaveCode_Decode 0x005EF3CC passes its own u8* arg3. No ctor, no vtable, no allocation site, so the 4-byte size is only max_strong_field+width.

fields.name: maybe_firstBufferByte
fields.evidence: Offset 0 is buf[0]: strb r5,[ip,#1] at 0x005F0218 and strb r3,[r0,r2] at 0x005F0264 in the shift body, and '*arg3 = *arg3 | (u8)(iVar4 << 2)' in SaveCode_Decode 0x005EF3CC. The batch's 4-byte u32 width comes from a mis-widened pointer in Ghidra; every observed access is byte-wise (strb).
